text:
maria: FYI new sample app fails in Next edge: import errors from our SDK. Looks like conditional exports + dual builds issue. :grimacing:

sam: which error? ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED or 'require is not defined'?

maria: both. Local dev gets ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED; in V8 edge runtime it throws 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' pointing at dist/index.cjs. Repro: clone sample -> yarn dev -> import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference' in middleware.ts

jia: Next edge uses V8 isolates, CJS won't work. Bundler/resolver probably picked the CJS root.

tyler: current package.json exports are too generic. We have main/module/types plus exports mapping node->cjs default->mjs. Next picks cjs for edge.

lucy: current package.json snippet: "main": "dist/index.cjs", "module": "dist/index.mjs", "types": "dist/index.d.ts", "exports": { "./package.json": "./package.json", "./*": { "node": "./dist/index.cjs", "default": "./dist/index.mjs" } }

sam: propose explicit exports with import/require and an "/edge" entry that points to ESM edge build. e.g. ".": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" }, "./*": "./dist/*"

jia: +1 to separate dist/node and dist/edge. Also ensure types resolution still works.

lucy: maybe add a temporary guidance: import '@redwood/inference/edge' in edge functions, update samples and onboarding.

maria: users won't discover that unless samples/docs updated. The sample used root import so it broke.

ops-bot: CI alert: canary smoke test for samples failed (suite #137). https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/137 :rotating_light:

tyler: action plan: 1) change exports to explicit import/require and add '/edge' entry, 2) split build output to dist/node and dist/edge, 3) update sample apps to import /edge for edge functions, 4) add V8 isolate smoke test to canary.

sam: I'll draft migration note + samples PR. Include bundler caveats (webpack/rollup may treat conditional exports differently).

jia: consider types mapping but simpler to keep single declaration set since API shape is identical. If we split, ensure dist/index.d.ts covers both.

lucy: long-term we should consider ESM-first package and a CJS compatibility bundle under a subpath; that's an RFC. For now do explicit exports + docs.

maria: I'll open PRs for package.json build changes, samples, and docs. Tagging @sam @tyler for review.

sam: thanks 31F
__notes: Slack-style thread: short messages, code snippets referenced, bot line. No title field per agents.md.
